note: 020A: branch stacking alone. Capacitance-minimised re-fit. iref 0.125 nA with bias_a_int m=4 (stage-A branch 0.50 nA) and bias_b_out m=1 (0.125 nA), so gm_f of both biquads carries almost the whole ladder current (I_lad 1.18 nA) -- that is what buys S7. Bridge/gmf_b widths set I_lad; their gate area is kept small because their Cgg is what caps the S1 phase certificate. 82.05 pF total (was 747.8).
